== Notes ==
* Bone Minions are useful with skill combinations that rely on the minions dying, such as [[Jagged Bones]], [[Death Nova]] or cause them to die, such as [[Putrid Flesh]] or [[Feast for the Dead]]. It is generally useful with [[build]]s that rely on [[Soul Reaping]] for [[energy management]].
* This spell will trigger [[Explosive Growth]], [[Boon of Creation]], and [[Spirit's Gift]] twice.

== Trivia ==
* The creature in the [[skill icon]] appears similar to a [[Scarab]].
